steps.code:
# Compute most common genre per playlist and update titles.
from collections import Counter

for pl in playlists:
    pl_id = pl['playlist_id']
    original_title = pl['title']
    song_ids = pl['song_ids']
    # Count genres in order of songs
    genre_counts = Counter()
    for sid in song_ids:
        genre = song_genres[sid]
        genre_counts[genre] += 1
    # Find max count
    max_count = max(genre_counts.values())
    # Get genres with max count, in order of first appearance in playlist
    candidates = []
    seen = set()
    for sid in song_ids:
        g = song_genres[sid]
        if g not in seen and genre_counts[g] == max_count:
            candidates.append(g)
            seen.add(g)
    most_common = candidates[0]  # first encountered with max count
    new_title = f"{original_title} | {most_common}"
    print(f"Updating playlist {pl_id}: '{original_title}' -> '{new_title}'")
    result = apis.spotify.update_playlist(
        playlist_id=pl_id,
        access_token=access_token,
        title=new_title
    )
    print(result)
